title: Pumpkin: modeled ₹776/qtl left, Anchal → Vandiperiyar
summary: January 2024: reported pumpkin prices at Anchal and Vandiperiyar imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 91% of 23 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹776 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 536 same-variety market pairs screened for pumpkin in January 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Vandiperiyar report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2024
scenes.caption: Anchal (Kerala) and Vandiperiyar (Kerala) both reported pumpkin prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 23 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Anchal reported a median ₹2,700 per quintal. Vandiperiyar reported a median ₹3,800 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,100/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,100 per quintal, and Vandiperiyar was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 136 km by road
scenes.caption: 136 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹29/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹729 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹530 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Vandiperiyar report, the rule selects 21 of 23 modeled shipping days. 20 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹776 per quintal (₹576 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Pumpkin route from Anchal to Vandiperiyar was positive on 91% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹77,600, or ₹57,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to pumpkin
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹29/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Pumpkin route from Anchal to Vandiperiyar was positive on 91% of matched days in January 2024. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹77,600, or ₹57,600 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

title: Pumpkin: modeled ₹541/qtl left, Kondotty → Aroor
summary: December 2024: reported pumpkin prices at Kondotty and Aroor imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 89% of 19 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹541 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 326 same-variety market pairs screened for pumpkin in December 2024; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Aroor report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.
